challenge.name: The Committed Pallets
challenge.description: A supplier has confirmed a bulk order for a middle aisle promotion that ships next week, leaving no room for model error. #requirements_reuben# insists the acceptance criteria must be fully governed to guarantee the allocation logic is auditable before the trucks leave. #reliability_ruth# argues the criteria are sufficient as manual checks because the physical stock is already committed and the team needs to ship the feature immediately to handle the live orders.

output.content: The committed pallets for the middle aisle promotion ship next week, and the physical stock is already locked in. The focus now must be on the live allocation orders to prevent out of stock scenarios on the shelf. I am willing to accept the data contracts remaining manual for this release. We are trading strict data governance for immediate operational capability. This allows the team to ship the feature quickly and handle the urgent replenishment needs. The risk of manual checks is manageable given the time pressure. We will revisit the automation of the contracts later, but the current priority is ensuring the trucks leave with the correct quantities for the promotion week.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept manual data contracts for this release, trading strict data governance for immediate operational capability to meet the urgent promotion deadline.
